chunks: God certainly heard the speech of the woman who argued with you about her husband and complained to God; and God heard your dialogue. Verily, God is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
ai.seo_question: Who is the woman mentioned in the Quran who argued with the Prophet about her husband?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in Medina, addresses Khawand bint Zayd al-Shaybani (also known as Khawand al-Mutabbirah), who presented her case directly to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) regarding her husband's declaration of Zihar and subsequent delay in consummation. It serves as the foundational text for the legal ruling of Kaffarat al-Zihar, emphasizing Allah’s direct awareness of private marital disputes and establishing a mechanism for justice that balances spiritual expiation with the restoration of spousal rights.
